LanguageData.RHAH_Thought_LeftAlone.stages.0.label: left alone
LanguageData.RHAH_Thought_LeftAlone.stages.0.descript: The basket is gone. Nobody came back for me today.
LanguageData.RHAH_Thought_CaptiveYear.stages.0.label: captive for a year
LanguageData.RHAH_Thought_CaptiveYear.stages.0.descri: I have been captive for a year. Whenever someone comes, I hope they will open that door for me.
LanguageData.RHAH_Thought_FamilyHere.stages.0.label: my child is still with me
LanguageData.RHAH_Thought_FamilyHere.stages.0.descrip: My child is still with me. I can watch my child grow up day by day.
LanguageData.RHAH_Thought_Regret.stages.0.label: regret for my lost child
LanguageData.RHAH_Thought_Regret.stages.0.description: My child is dead. I keep wishing I had done more that day.
LanguageData.RHAH_Thought_MotherGoneBad.stages.0.desc: My mother left me here. I still remember where she put me.
LanguageData.RHAH_Thought_MotherGoneGood.stages.0.des: After my mother left, the people here fed me. I finally had enough to eat.
LanguageData.RHAH_Thought_AteMotherGuilt.stages.0.des: I ate my own mother. I still remember that bite.
LanguageData.RHAH_Thought_AteMotherFine.stages.0.desc: I was starving, so I ate my mother. All I wanted then was a full stomach.
LanguageData.RHAH_Thought_AteMotherFine.stages.0.labe: ate my mother to fill my stomach
LanguageData.RHAH_Thought_AidAgain.stages.0.descripti: They gave me food this time. I want to ask them again the next time I am hungry.
LanguageData.RHAH_Thought_AidAgain.stages.0.label: ask for food again
LanguageData.RHAH_Thought_AidEmpty.stages.0.descripti: The food I received will run out. I need to find someone else willing to help.
LanguageData.RHAH_Thought_AidEmpty.stages.0.label: need another source of food
LanguageData.RHAH_Thought_TraderSilent.stages.0.descr: I caught the disease that caravan brought. They never mentioned it when they arrived.
LanguageData.RHAH_Thought_TraderSilent.stages.0.label: the caravan hid its sickness
LanguageData.RHAH_Thought_MotherSorry.stages.0.descri: I was so hungry that I bit my mother. She is alive, but I feel guilty whenever I think of it.
LanguageData.RHAH_Thought_MotherSorry.stages.0.label: guilt over biting my mother
LanguageData.RHAH_Thought_MotherFine.stages.0.descrip: I bit my mother when I was hungry. She is still alive. I do not think it mattered.
LanguageData.RHAH_Thought_MotherFine.stages.0.label: bit my mother and felt fine
LanguageData.RHAH_Thought_ChildDeadGlad.stages.0.desc: The child who bit me is dead. I can finally stop fearing those bites.
LanguageData.RHAH_Thought_ChildDeadGlad.stages.0.labe: the child who bit me died
LanguageData.RHAH_Thought_ChildDeadSad.stages.0.descr: My child is dead. The child who once bit me out of hunger.
LanguageData.RHAH_Thought_ChildDeadSad.stages.0.label: my child died
LanguageData.RHAH_Thought_ChildStarvedSad.stages.0.de: I brought my child out to beg for food, but my child still starved to death.
LanguageData.RHAH_Thought_ChildStarvedGlad.stages.0.d: My child starved to death. All I can think is that I have one less mouth to feed.
LanguageData.RHAH_Thought_StealHurtBad.stages.0.descr: They hurt me when I took food. It still hurts to think about it.
LanguageData.RHAH_Thought_StealHurtBad.stages.0.label: hurt while taking food
LanguageData.RHAH_Thought_StealHurtGood.stages.0.desc: They beat me when I took food. Now I live here with them. I think it was worth it.
LanguageData.RHAH_Thought_StealMine.stages.0.descript: I grabbed the food in front of me. I felt that no one should take it from me.
LanguageData.RHAH_Thought_StealMine.stages.0.label: the food I took was mine
LanguageData.RHAH_Thought_StealGot.stages.0.descripti: I grabbed something to eat. Filling my stomach mattered more than anything then.
LanguageData.RHAH_Thought_StealGot.stages.0.label: got food by force
LanguageData.RHAH_Thought_SoldAway.stages.0.descripti: I was bought like a piece of merchandise. Someone else even decided where I would go.
LanguageData.RHAH_Thought_SoldAway.stages.0.label: bought and taken away
LanguageData.RHAH_Thought_SoldFed.stages.0.descriptio: I was bought and brought here. At least they feed me here.
LanguageData.RHAH_Thought_SoldFed.stages.0.label: fed after being bought
LanguageData.RHAH_Thought_TradedAway.stages.0.descrip: They traded me for food and left me with strangers.
LanguageData.RHAH_Thought_TradedAway.stages.0.label: they traded me away
LanguageData.RHAH_Thought_TradedFed.stages.0.descript: I was traded to this place. There is food here, and I want to stay.
LanguageData.RHAH_Thought_TradedFed.stages.0.label: traded to a place with food
LanguageData.RHAH_Thought_FineGood.stages.0.descripti: The meal they gave me was delicious. I had not eaten anything like it in a long time.
LanguageData.RHAH_Thought_FineGood.stages.0.label: a good meal
LanguageData.RHAH_Thought_FineKeep.stages.0.descripti: The food they gave me is too good to eat all at once. I want to save some for the next time I am hungry.
LanguageData.RHAH_Thought_FineKeep.stages.0.label: saving the good food
LanguageData.RHAH_Thought_MedicineEnough.stages.0.des: They gave me medicine. I finally have something for this illness or injury.
LanguageData.RHAH_Thought_MedicineNext.stages.0.descr: I got medicine this time. Who will I ask if I fall ill again?
LanguageData.RHAH_Thought_MedicineNext.stages.0.label: worried about medicine
LanguageData.RHAH_Thought_SilverLight.stages.0.descri: They gave me silver. I can carry it with me and look for someone selling food.
LanguageData.RHAH_Thought_SilverLight.stages.0.label: received silver
LanguageData.RHAH_Thought_SilverHard.stages.0.descrip: I have the silver, but I am still hungry. I still have to find someone selling food.
LanguageData.RHAH_Thought_SilverHard.stages.0.label: silver but still hungry
LanguageData.RHAH_Thought_TakenBad.stages.0.descripti: Strangers took me away from the adults I was with. After that, I had to live with them.
LanguageData.RHAH_Thought_TakenBad.stages.0.label: taken by strangers
LanguageData.RHAH_Thought_TakenFed.stages.0.descripti: They took me and brought me here. At least they feed me.
LanguageData.RHAH_Thought_TakenFed.stages.0.label: fed after being taken in
LanguageData.RHAH_Thought_ExtraMouth.stages.0.descrip: My child was born, but I still worry about the next meal. Now I have someone else to feed.
LanguageData.RHAH_Thought_ExtraMouth.stages.0.label: another mouth
LanguageData.RHAH_Thought_BornAlive.stages.0.descript: My child was born and survived. I am happy just to see my child here.
LanguageData.RHAH_Thought_BornAlive.stages.0.label: my child survived
LanguageData.RHAH_Thought_FellBad.stages.0.descriptio: My drop pod landed here. There was no one I knew around me.
LanguageData.RHAH_Thought_FellBad.stages.0.label: landed among strangers
LanguageData.RHAH_Thought_FellGood.stages.0.descripti: My drop pod landed here, and the people here gave me food.
LanguageData.RHAH_Thought_FellGood.stages.0.label: fed after my pod landed
LanguageData.RHAH_Thought_WrongKinBad.stages.0.descri: I mistook a stranger for my mother. I still do not know where my mother is.
LanguageData.RHAH_Thought_WrongKinBad.stages.0.label: mistook a stranger for my mother
LanguageData.RHAH_Thought_WrongKinGood.stages.0.descr: I mistook someone here for my mother. Even though I was wrong, they gave me food.
LanguageData.RHAH_Thought_WrongKinGood.stages.0.label: mistaken but still fed
My mother left me here and later died. I cannot even see her once more.
my mother left me and died
LanguageData.RHAH_Thought_PlagueMotherDeadGood.stages: My mother died, but I survived the plague. I can still eat and keep living.
LanguageData.RHAH_Thought_PlagueLeft.stages.0.descrip: I had the plague when my mother left. I still remember those days of sickness.
LanguageData.RHAH_Thought_PlagueLeft.stages.0.label: sick when my mother left
LanguageData.RHAH_Thought_PlagueLived.stages.0.descri: I was still sick when my mother left. At least I survived the plague.
LanguageData.RHAH_Thought_PlagueLived.stages.0.label: survived the plague
LanguageData.RHAH_Thought_OrphanBad.stages.0.descript: The plague nearly killed me. I am still afraid of catching it again.
LanguageData.RHAH_Thought_OrphanBad.stages.0.label: nearly died of plague
LanguageData.RHAH_Thought_OrphanGood.stages.0.descrip: I survived the plague. I can still eat now.
LanguageData.RHAH_Thought_OrphanGood.stages.0.label: survived and can still eat
LanguageData.RHAH_Thought_CleanBirth.stages.0.descrip: I had the plague, but my child has not caught it. Seeing my child well is a relief.
LanguageData.RHAH_Thought_CleanBirth.stages.0.label: my child is free of plague
LanguageData.RHAH_Thought_NextBirth.stages.0.descript: This child has not caught the plague. If I have another, I am afraid we may not be so lucky.
LanguageData.RHAH_Thought_NextBirth.stages.0.label: afraid for my next child
LanguageData.RHAH_Thought_BornSick.stages.0.descripti: My child had the plague at birth. So young, and already suffering.
LanguageData.RHAH_Thought_BornSick.stages.0.label: my child was born with plague
LanguageData.RHAH_Thought_DropSick.stages.0.descripti: I already had the plague when my drop pod landed here. I was afraid I would not survive.
LanguageData.RHAH_Thought_DropSick.stages.0.label: had plague when my pod landed
LanguageData.RHAH_Thought_DropLived.stages.0.descript: I had the plague when my drop pod landed here. Now I have survived it.
LanguageData.RHAH_Thought_DropLived.stages.0.label: survived plague after landing
LanguageData.RHAH_Thought_WrongSick.stages.0.descript: I mistook someone here for my mother while I had the plague. I remember the confusion and the sickness.
LanguageData.RHAH_Thought_WrongSick.stages.0.label: mistook someone for mother while sick
LanguageData.RHAH_Thought_WrongFed.stages.0.descripti: I mistook someone here for my mother. They took me in and fed me anyway.
LanguageData.RHAH_Thought_WrongFed.stages.0.label: taken in despite my mistake
